Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the March 14, 2022, meeting.

  2. Shaffer Psychological Institute– Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing services to our Human Resources Department.

  3. Alta Environmental, L.P – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing services for the Emergency Operations Center.

  4. MGT Consulting Group- Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  services to the Finance Department.

  5. Bartel Associates, LLC – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  actuarial valuation services to our Finance Department.

  6. California Municipal Statistics, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment
  for bond information provided to the Finance Department.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.
